user.title: Connect to Waymote
user.description: Enter the address of the Waymote bridge on your caravan network.

outputs.title: Name your outputs
outputs.description: Type a name for each output that is wired. Leave a row blank to hide that output. You can change these later from the integration's settings.

domains.title: Choose a type for each output
domains.description: Pick what each output actually is. The guess is based on the name — correct any that are wrong. Lights become light entities, fans become fans, everything else stays a switch.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the Waymote bridge at that address.
error.invalid_response: That address answered, but it does not look like a Waymote bridge.
error.write_failed: Could not save the names to the Waymote bridge. Check it is still reachable and try again.

abort.already_configured: This Waymote bridge is already set up.
abort.reconfigure_failed: Could not update the Waymote configuration.
